اجتذبوا (form VIII)
# اِجْتَذَبُوا (ijtaḏabū) /id͡ʒ.ta.ða.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اُجْتُذِبُوا (ujtuḏibū) /ud͡ʒ.tu.ði.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# اِجْتَذِبُوا (ijtaḏibū) /id͡ʒ.ta.ði.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
